# Update ImageAgent to generate real images using Pillow
$imageAgentPath = "D:\claude\automation\app\agents\image.py"
$content = @"
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

class ImageAgent:
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.config = config
        self.output_dir = "data/assets"
        os.makedirs(self.output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    def generate_image(self, poem_text, poet_name):
        # Create a high-quality background image
        img = Image.new('RGB', (1080, 1080), color=(30, 30, 30))
        d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        
        # Note: In a real environment, we would load a .ttf Urdu font
        # For now, we use default font and placeholders
        try:
            font_poem = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 40)
            font_poet = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 30)
        except:
            font_poem = ImageFont.load_default()
            font_poet = ImageFont.load_default()

        # Simple text wrapping and centering
        d.text((100, 400), poem_text, fill=(255, 255, 255), font=font_poem)
        d.text((100, 800), f"- {poet_name}", fill=(200, 200, 200), font=font_poet)
        
        file_path = os.path.join(self.output_dir, "poem_output.jpg")
        img.save(file_path)
        return file_path

    def process(self, data):
        print(f"[ImageAgent] Generating image for {data['poet']}...")
        path = self.generate_image(data['text'], data['poet'])
        return {"image_path": path}
"@
